A CONFESSION FROM YOUR GREATEST PROBLEM

Plot twist, Babi.

I never imagined myself falling for a criminology guy kay i swore before nga dili jud ko ma fall ug crim student but wala eh. In fact, I used to think that was one thing I would never do when it came to relationships.

But then you happened. Ga join lang man kas live nako sauna sa TikTok. Sige ra kag pabuyag didto. And somehow, the boy I never expected to love became someone I never want to take for granted. My love, my babi, I love you po.

Life really has a funny way of proving us wrong, doesn't it?
